bio.text: Rudy Recile is the Republican candidate for California's 8th Congressional District in 2026.
Born in Hamilton, Ontario, Canada, he served in the U.S. Army from 1988 to 2014 and retired as a major, according to his candidate statement.
He earned a bachelor's degree from Eastern Illinois University in 1995 and a graduate degree from National Graduate School in 2005.
His statement says he is a former U.S. Department of Agriculture employee and owner of a small web design company, and that his family has lived in Solano County for 18 years.
